title: smyrnium libanotis
intro: Smyrnium libanotis, commonly known as meadow celery, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of meadow celery include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-spasmodic agent, making it effective in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of meadow celery include volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
